mainEntity.name: What is an ADU and why would I build one?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a secondary dwelling unit on a single-family or multi-family residential lot. Building an ADU can provide additional living space for family members, generate rental income, or increase property value. Before starting, consider your primary motivation, such as housing a relative or renting it out, as this will influence the design and features of the unit.
